amendment: ruleset-v3 — supersedes v2 (v1/v2 never mutate). Adds the ability-taxonomy reform: registerPrintedTriggers (BUG FIX: printed event triggers were never registered, so ~29 abilities incl. Last Breath silently never fired), equipmentTriggers (BUG FIX: attached equipment's own triggers were never in the pool), reactAbilities (new [React] category: procs exhaust the source and cannot proc while exhausted), activateAfterDeploy (bot tempo fix: a paid activated ability no longer pre-empts an affordable deploy). Adds heroAuras (BUG FIX: hero/transformed static auras were never applied — collectAuraSources never included the Hero, so Seraphina Holy Ward, Valkyrie ATK=ARM, Lyria Knowledge Shield and Lyria-T Supreme Intellect were all inert). Authored 2026-07-25. Each flag is byte-identical when OFF so v1/v2 history and replays are preserved.
